title: shadcn/ui
notes: Approved seed. shadcn/ui is open source; the GitHub repo LICENSE.md is MIT. The docs call the defaults a clean, minimal look, and describe the project as accessible components plus a code distribution platform. Their own line is that this is how you build your component library, rather than an npm package you import. This catalog still uses kind component_library because that is the approved seed kind. Public stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and Radix.
